open_app.label: App opened
open_app.description: An app cold start after the first launch; returning from background does not count.

pet_buy.label: Pet purchased
pet_buy.description: A player purchases a pet during a stage.

sup_buy.label: Support item purchased
sup_buy.description: A player purchases a support item during a stage.

skl_pick.label: Skill selected
skl_pick.description: A player selects a skill card during a stage.

trn_use.label: Terrain used
trn_use.description: A pet first enters a terrain area in an attempt; each terrain is tracked once per attempt.

cp.label: Interrupted stage checkpoint
cp.description: The next cold start reports the stage and wave left unfinished when the app exited.

stg_cmp.label: Stage completed
stg_cmp.description: A player wins a stage. Play time accumulates foreground minutes across attempts up to the first win.

stg_fail.label: Stage failed
stg_fail.description: A player fails a stage at the tracked wave.

login_day.label: Login day reached
login_day.description: A player reaches the tracked login day.

pet_asc.label: Pet ascended
pet_asc.description: A player ascends a pet to the tracked target.

x2_speed_on.label: Double speed enabled
x2_speed_on.description: A player enables double battle speed.

rr_trd.label: Trader pets rerolled
rr_trd.description: A player rerolls the pet offers at the trader during a stage.

ms_claim.label: Milestone reward claimed
ms_claim.description: A player claims a milestone reward.

cst_fail.label: Consecutive failures
cst_fail.description: A player reaches a tracked consecutive failure count.

cst_fail_wa.label: Consecutive wave failures
cst_fail_wa.description: A player reaches a tracked consecutive failure count at a wave.

cst_fail_heat.label: Failure streak intensity
cst_fail_heat.description: A failure streak is grouped by its tracked intensity and time gap.

gacha.label: Gacha draw
gacha.description: A player makes a gacha draw, with pool, quantity and cost recorded.

gacha_feeling.label: Post-gacha behavior category
gacha_feeling.description: The first qualifying action after a draw classifies behavior as positive, normal or negative; this is not a self-reported feeling.

cst_win.label: Consecutive wins
cst_win.description: A player reaches a tracked consecutive win count.

dg_rwd.label: Daily gift reward claimed
dg_rwd.description: A player claims a daily gift reward.

ds_rwd.label: Daily shop reward claimed
ds_rwd.description: A player claims a daily shop reward.

ds_buy.label: Daily shop item purchased
ds_buy.description: A player purchases an item in the daily shop.

ds_rr.label: Daily shop rerolled
ds_rr.description: A player rerolls the daily shop.

pet_upg.label: Pet upgraded
pet_upg.description: A player upgrades the tracked pet.

hero_upg.label: Hero upgraded
hero_upg.description: A player upgrades the tracked hero.

item_upg.label: Item upgraded
item_upg.description: A player upgrades the tracked item.

trd_use.label: Board occupancy category
trd_use.description: At wave start, occupied pet/support tiles are grouped as full at 90% or more, normal at 40% to under 90%, or least below 40%.
